newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sunstone Hotel estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sunstone Hotel estimates raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it raised its earnings estimate for Sunstone Hotel Investors Inc in 1997 to $1.39 a share from $1.35 and the estimate for 1998 to $1.65 from $1.54.

-- EVEREN said the move follows a meeting with the company's management that indicated improved operating performance for the comapny's hotels in the first quarter and for the year thanks in part to a strong economy in California.
-- Sunstone Hotel's portfolio performance for January and February is up at a rate of nearly 20 percent on a same-store basis, about double the national average of 10 percent, EVEREN said.
-- Sunstone Hotel is a real estate investment trust.
-- Its shares were unchanged Tuesday at 13-7/8.
